# Features

## iPhone

### Home

| Feature | Where | Anchor |
|---|---|---|
| Tonight card | top of Home | `home.tonight` |
| Shelf | below the card | `home.shelf` |

### Recipe list

| Feature | Where | Anchor |
|---|---|---|
| Search | top of the list | `recipes.search` |
| Add button | top right | `recipes.add` |

### Recipe detail

| Feature | Where | Anchor |
|---|---|---|
| Step timer | in each step | `recipe.timer` |

### Recipe editor

| Feature | Where | Anchor |
|---|---|---|
| Photo picker | top | `editor.photo` |

### Shopping list

| Feature | Where | Anchor |
|---|---|---|
| Tick off | row tap | `shopping.tick` |

### Meal planner

| Feature | Where | Anchor |
|---|---|---|
| Week grid | the planner tab | `planner.week` |
| Drag a recipe to a day | the week grid | `planner.drag` |

### Sharing

| Feature | Where | Anchor |
|---|---|---|
| Share sheet | recipe menu | `share.sheet` |
